title: Moderation
intro: Hide product listings or reviews that break the guidelines. Hidden items stay in the database with the reason; the owner is told.

text.review: It is removed from customer pages right away. The customer is told and can contact the team.
text.listing: It is removed from customer pages right away. The stall is told and can contact the team.

hide.done: Hidden. The owner has been told.

reason.offTopic: Not about the product or stall

empty.title: Nothing to moderate
empty.text: Reported products and reviews arrive here for you to read before hiding anything.

messages.boundary: You can read only messages someone reported, plus up to five on each side for context. Nothing else in a conversation is open to admins.
messages.emptyText: When a customer or a stall reports a message, it waits here for you.
messages.hideText: Both people in the conversation stop seeing it. The report is marked as actioned.

hiddenQueue.noListingsText: Listings you hide appear here with the reason, so you can put them back.

quality.boundary: Only a confirmed report on an extended shelf life that spoiled before its date records a strike. Nothing happens to a stall just because a customer reported.
quality.emptyText: Spoiled reports from customers wait here for you.
quality.details: Customer: {{customer}} · picked up {{pickup}} · good until {{bestBefore}} · spoiled {{spoiled}} ({{when}})
quality.photoAlt: The customer's photo of the spoiled produce
quality.dismissText: The report closes without a strike. The customer and the stall are told.
quality.confirmText: The report closes as confirmed. The customer and the stall are told.
quality.confirmStrike: The stall extended this shelf life and it spoiled before its date, so a strike is recorded and the product goes back to the suggested shelf life.
quality.noteLabel: Why it is not the stall's fault
quality.noteOptional: Note for the stall and other admins (optional)
quality.noteRequired: Say why this is not the stall's fault.
quality.done: Decision saved. The customer and the stall have been told.
quality.alreadyDecided: Another admin has already decided on this report.
